title: The strict lower-bound conjecture for the robust clique covering number
source: Gábor Bacsó, Balázs Patkós, Zsolt Tuza and Máté Vizer, “The robust chromatic number of graphs”, arXiv:2305.01923 (2023). (https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.01923)

lanes.final_paper_and_definition_check: final-paper-check-358270-355218-opus-20261118-r1/CHECK-358270.md (Claude Opus 5.5, PASS WITH EDITORIAL EDITS; definitions literal; revised paper used)

significance.root_decision: For every finite simple graph G, the robust clique covering number theta_1(G) (the maximum, over 1-selections in which each vertex selects one incident edge, of the clique covering number after deleting the selected edges) equals the clique covering number theta(G) if and only if G has no edges. This is Conjecture 1 of the source, proved without the isolate-free hypothesis of the MathDB record. The argument modifies the proofs of Proposition 7 and Theorem 6 of the source by an explicit 1-selection. Significance is modest: a short argument on a question the source authors left open.
significance.caveat: Close call on significance (a few-line variant of the source technique; user may overrule). The journal version of the source is unread (publisher bot challenge).
